g.text: Four candidates: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost,
and LightGBM. Random Forest had the highest global ROC AUC,
but it collapsed to the majority class at threshold 0.50.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #d97706

g.text: LightGBM was selected for practical default detection. At the
32.1%. These figures are optimistic because the hold-out test
set was used for threshold calibration.

font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f766e

g.text: SHAP identified the main risk drivers as interest rate, debt-
to-income ratio, and loan grade. This connects model
predictions to borrower-level and global explanations.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f766e

g.text: Using income as a proxy and False Positive Rate parity: low-
income FPR = 0.07%; high-income FPR = 0.13%. No evidence of
disparate impact was found under the evaluated metric.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #102a43
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #102a43

g.text: A constrained LightGBM framework can provide useful minority-class discrimination
while remaining interpretable through SHAP. Deployment requires leakage controls,
validation-based threshold selection, monitoring, and governance.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b42318

g.text: used only as a proxy; test-set threshold
results are not a definitive deployment

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Reproducibility: Python 3.13.5 | scikit-learn 1.8 | LightGBM 4.7 | imbalanced-learn 0.11 | seed = 42
